meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把静态设计变成动感短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做短视频或社媒素材，想让画面更有动感
copy.tagline_en: Turn static designs into eye-catching motion shorts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you make short videos or social media content and want more dynamic visuals.

howto.what: 装上后，每次要制作动效时，Claude 会先询问是否更新技能，然后按流程制作短时动态图形（通常10秒内）：规划素材、设计动画、构建并检查，最后征得同意后渲染成 MP4 或透明视频。
howto.when: 当你要求制作短时设计动效（动效文字、数字动画、图表动画等），或提供网页/推文等素材时触发；时长更长或有旁白时转其他流程。

say.text: 做一个数字从 0 滚到 100 的动画。
say.note: Claude 会按数字动效流程制作。

say.text: 把这句话做成动效字幕：“未来已来”。
用这个 logo 做一个 5 秒片头。

howto.what_en: After setup, when a motion task starts, Claude will first confirm updating the skill, then produce a short design-led motion graphic (usually under 10s): plan assets, design animation, build & verify, and render to MP4/transparent overlay after user approval.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a short design-led motion (e.g. kinetic type, stat count-up, chart animation) or provide material like a webpage/tweet; longer or narrated requests go to another flow.

say_en.text: Make a number count from 0 to 100.
say_en.note: Claude will follow the stat motion flow.

say_en.text: Turn this sentence into kinetic type: 'The future is here'.
say_en.note: It will produce a motion typography video.

say_en.text: Make a 5-second logo sting with this logo.
say_en.note: It will create a logo reveal animation.
